findings.title: Course announcements rendered unescaped with th:utext
findings.sink: th:utext rendering of rich-text fields (no shared HTML sanitizer)
findings.description: Announcement bodies are rendered with th:utext. Any instructor or co-teacher account can publish markup that runs script for every student enrolled in the course.

findings.title: CSRF protection disabled globally
findings.description: SecurityConfig disables CSRF protection for all routes with http.csrf(csrf -> csrf.disable()). Browser sessions for grade submission and enrollment changes are exposed to cross-site request forgery.

findings.title: Sessions stay valid for 30 days
findings.description: server.servlet.session.timeout is set to 30d, so sessions on shared lab computers stay valid for weeks.

findings.cweName: Information Exposure Through an Error Message
findings.title: API errors return raw exception messages
findings.description: The global exception handler returns ex.getMessage() to API clients, which includes SQL constraint names and internal hostnames.

findings.title: Email regex vulnerable to catastrophic backtracking
findings.description: The sign-up email validator uses a nested-quantifier pattern that backtracks exponentially on long inputs, so one crafted request can tie up a request thread.

findings.title: Any logged-in user can remove students from a course
findings.description: The endpoint that removes a student from a course only checks that the caller is logged in, not that they teach the course.
